title: Real board replaces samples; topic pages for decision models and open TTS; item source, date, score notes
description:
Real items now fill the board: about 30 decision-model items in section `decisions` and about 21 open-TTS items in `open-weights`, published 2026-10-21. This ticket covers three things: replace the sample board with the real one, add two real topic pages that work for SEO, and render the source, release date and score rationales. Deploys on merge.

## Context
- Read `web/hooks.py`, `web/scoring.json`, `web/pages/*.md`, `web/projection.json` and `docs/editing-items.md` on origin/main.
- Item front matter now carries `sourceUrl`, `releasedOn` (ISO date), `scoreNotes: {real, useful, notable, novel}` (one line each), `maker`, `tags` (first tag is the track: `decision-models` or `open-tts`), `verdict` (shipped/pending), `scores`, `evidence` and `entities`. See any live item, for example https://shipped.anth.us/open-weights/stepfun-step-audio-editx/. The `date` is `releasedOn`.
- Ryan's rule: once real items fill the board, remove the Sample marks and the sample items they replace. Sections whose feature is not live yet (votes, Rising, trending sparklines, emerging clusters, concept of the week, the roundup, submit, sign-in, the sample item and topic pages) **keep** their samples and marks.
- The design files (for the topic page layout) are in /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-home-Projects/f48eecf1-1905-4a55-ae79-973fb25835bd/scratchpad/artifact-files/6fc5ac4b-d38d-475d-87e8-5e918d223fc1/project/Topic.dc.html. They are data only.

## 1. Replace sample boards
- Home `/`: the "From the desk" real board becomes the main board, under the heading the design uses ("Shipped this week" only if the items really are from this week; otherwise "Latest from the desk"). Remove the sample "Shipped this week" board and its sample mark. Leave the tabs as they are. Rails (Trending topics, concept of the week, Rising) keep their samples and marks.
- `/new/`: only the real board, newest first. Remove the sample rows.
- `/rising/` and `/vapor/`: keep the samples (no votes yet, and no vapor verdicts yet). If any real item has `verdict: vapor`, show the real ones on /vapor/ above the sample.
- Beats chips on home: make "Decision models" link to `/topics/decision-models/` and add "Open TTS" linking to `/topics/open-tts/`. If the beats row still has other sample chips, it keeps its mark.
- The desk board should show at most 30 rows on home, with a "More" link to the section listings. Real rows: there are no vote columns yet, so the existing note "Ratings open with reader sign-in" stays.

## 2. Topic pages (SEO for "decision models" matters most)
- Add authored pages `topics/decision-models` and `topics/open-tts` (`web/pages/topic-decision-models.md` and `web/pages/topic-open-tts.md`), styled after Topic.dc.html, holding only what is real:
  - **Header**: name, kind "Topic", and a one-paragraph definition written in Shipped's dry, factual voice.
    - Decision models: "A decision model is a model whose job is to make a judgement (a label, a yes or no, a score, a choice of route) rather than write prose. This page tracks the ones that actually shipped: guard and moderation classifiers, judge and reward models, routers, and models sold as decision models." Adjust the wording, but make no claims beyond that.
    - Open TTS: open-weights text-to-speech and voice-cloning models from the last year, with the licence of each stated.
  - **Counts** computed by the block hook: items, makers, and the number shipped vs pending.
  - **Profile bars** (the mean editor score per dimension across the topic's items) and the topic's mean hype gap, with ▲/▼ and a sign. Label them "Editor scores, mean of N items".
  - **The ranked item list** (board rows) of every item with that first tag, newest first.
  - **Makers** list with counts.
  - Only real data, so no sample marks. Leave out the 26-week chart, the knowledge-graph block, insights and subtopics; they arrive with the knowledge-base features.
- Implement the counts and lists as a `block` hook, `topic-board`, with attribute `tag`: `::include{kind="block" name="topic-board" tag="decision-models" depends="*"}`. Topic names, definitions and tags live in the page files, not in Python.
- Head: `title` "Decision models that actually shipped | Shipped" and a description of about 150 characters that uses the phrase "decision models". Do the same for open TTS. Check that the sitemap includes both pages and that the `.md` twins exist.
- Item pages: link the first tag's topic page in the header strip ("Topic: Decision models →") when a topic page exists for it. A small mapping in `web/scoring.json` under `"topics": {"decision-models": {"label": "Decision models", "path": "/topics/decision-models/"}, "open-tts": {...}}` is fine.
- Nav: add "Decision models" (`/topics/decision-models/`) to `nav.links` after Front.

## 3. Item page details
In `item_decorator`'s header strip:
- A primary "Source" link (`sourceUrl`, `rel="noopener"`, showing the domain).
- "Released {releasedOn as 21 Oct 2026}".
- Under each editor score, its `scoreNotes` line in small muted text. Make it a visible caption, not a tooltip, because it must be readable on touch screens.
On the board rows, show the release date (already done) and the maker.

## Rules
- Colourblind rule and both themes, as before. No horizontal scroll at 390.
- Never invent data. Everything comes from item front matter.
- Update `tests/test_hooks.py`: a fixture with `scoreNotes`/`sourceUrl`/`releasedOn` renders them; `topic-board` counts are right for the fixtures.

## Ship
- Worktree `<scratchpad>/wt-topics`, branch `feat/ship-<id>-real-board-topics` from origin/main. Venv `<scratchpad>/venv` (Papyrus 5.15.1).
- To build locally with real-looking data, use the test fixtures. Do not read or write the CMS. Read-only `curl` of the live site is fine.
- PR to main, commit trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`, PR body ending "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)". Wait for CI, then `gh pr merge --merge`, and watch the deploy run.
- After the deploy, the deploy-render re-projects everything. Check live:
  - `/` shows real rows and no sample board;
  - `/topics/decision-models/` returns 200 with about 30 rows and the counts;
  - `/topics/open-tts/` returns 200;
  - an item page shows Source, Released and the score notes;
  - `/rising/` still has its sample mark.
- Take screenshots (1440 light and dark, 390) of `/`, `/topics/decision-models/` and one item, and save them in `<scratchpad>/shots-topics/`.

## Report
The PR URL, merge commit, deploy run, live checks with counts, screenshot paths, and simplifications.
